concepts.title: Closing Stock Adjustment and Adjusted Purchases
concepts.definition: Closing stock represents the value of unsold inventory at the end of the financial period, which can either be credited to the trading account or adjusted directly through purchases.
concepts.key_idea: Closing stock is credited to trading account and shown as a current asset, or adjusted via purchases to show adjusted purchases on the debit side.

concepts.title: Outstanding Expenses Adjustment
concepts.definition: Unpaid expenses incurred during the current financial period are outstanding expenses and must be added to the relevant expense head and recorded as a current liability.
concepts.key_idea: Accrual basis mandates adding unpaid costs to current year expenses and recognizing a corresponding liability.
question_patterns: calculate total expense to be debited to profit and loss account including outstanding amount

concepts.title: Prepaid Expenses Adjustment
concepts.definition: Expenses paid in advance whose benefits extend into the subsequent accounting period are deducted from total expenses and presented as current assets.
concepts.key_idea: Advance payments for future periods are excluded from current P&L expense and carried forward as assets.

concepts.title: Accrued Income Adjustment
concepts.definition: Income earned during the current period but not yet received in cash by the end of the year is added to total revenue and listed as a current asset.
concepts.key_idea: Revenues earned but uncollected are recognized in the profit and loss account and shown under current assets.
question_patterns: calculate total income earned including accrued revenue

concepts.title: Income Received in Advance Adjustment
concepts.definition: Revenue received during the current period that relates to future accounting periods must be deducted from current income and reported as a current liability.
concepts.key_idea: Unearned revenue collected in advance is excluded from current income and treated as a liability.
question_patterns: calculate net earned income when advance receipt is included

concepts.title: Depreciation Adjustment
concepts.definition: Depreciation is the reduction in book value of fixed assets due to wear, tear, and usage over time, charged as a expense in P&L and deducted from asset cost in Balance Sheet.
concepts.key_idea: Depreciation allocates fixed asset cost as an expense, reducing net profit and asset book value.

concepts.title: Bad Debts and Further Bad Debts Adjustment
concepts.definition: Irrecoverable debts written off during the period are recorded as bad debts; additional irrecoverable amounts identified at year-end are further bad debts that reduce debtors balance.
concepts.key_idea: Further bad debts increase total bad debt expense in P&L and directly reduce sundry debtors in the balance sheet.
question_patterns: calculate total bad debts expense for profit and loss account

concepts.title: Provision for Bad and Doubtful Debts Adjustment
concepts.definition: An estimated provision set aside from profits to cover potential future losses from doubtful debts, calculated as a percentage of good debtors after deducting further bad debts.
concepts.key_idea: New provision is computed on debtors after deducting further bad debts, and the net charge to P&L accounts for old provision balances.

concepts.title: Provision for Discount on Debtors Adjustment
concepts.definition: A provision created on good debtors (after deducting bad debts and provision for doubtful debts) to estimate discounts to be allowed for prompt payment in the next period.
concepts.key_idea: Discount provision is estimated only on good debtors remaining after all bad debt adjustments.
question_patterns: calculate provision for discount on debtors

concepts.title: Manager's Commission Adjustment
concepts.definition: Remuneration allowed to a manager calculated as a percentage of net profits, either before or after charging such commission.
concepts.formula: commission = profit * rate / 100 OR commission = profit * rate / (100 + rate)
concepts.key_idea: Commission before charging uses rate/100; commission after charging uses rate/(100 + rate).

concepts.title: Interest on Capital Adjustment
concepts.definition: Interest allowed to the proprietor on capital invested in business, treated as a business expense in P&L and credited to capital account in Balance Sheet.
concepts.key_idea: Interest on capital is charged to profit and loss account as an expense and added to capital in the balance sheet.

concepts.title: Depreciation on Fixed Assets
concepts.definition: The systematic allocation of the cost of a tangible asset over its useful life, recorded as an expense in the Profit and Loss account and deducted from the asset value in the Balance Sheet.
concepts.key_idea: Reduces the book value of fixed assets and charges the reduction as an operating expense.

concepts.definition: An estimate of potential losses from credit sales that may become uncollectible, calculated as a percentage of outstanding debtors after deducting further bad debts.
concepts.key_idea: Created to adhere to the conservatism principle, reducing debtors in the balance sheet and charging P&L.

concepts.title: Net Bad Debts Expense in Profit and Loss
